Container.Name: unraid-mobile
Container.Overview: Unraid Mobile read-only system metrics preview. Mount /proc and /sys read-only for CPU, memory, network and CPU temperature. Missing host data is shown explicitly. Docker/VM/Array/Parity operations are not enabled. No privileged access is required for the system metrics preview.
